name: AdaptiveInstanceNormalization2DBackward
reference:
import torch

def run(grad_output, x, weight, mean, std):
    N, C, H, W = x.shape
    grad_input = grad_output * weight.reshape(1, C, 1, 1) / std
    grad_weight = (grad_output * (x - mean) / std).sum(dim=(0, 2, 3))
    grad_bias = grad_output.sum(dim=(0, 2, 3))
    return grad_input, grad_weight, grad_bias
description: Backward pass of Adaptive Instance Normalization (AdaIN). Computes gradients w.r.t. input, weight, and bias. Pure PyTorch: gradient computation for (x-mean)/std * weight + bias.
